title: Certificates
subtitle: Manage Let's Encrypt TLS certificates for your sites.
empty.title: No TLS sites yet
empty.desc: Add a site with TLS enabled to manage its certificate here.
orders.title: Certificate orders
orders.description: One row per TLS-enabled site. Status updates automatically while an issuance is in flight.
prod.title: Switch to Let's Encrypt Production?
prod.body1: Production has a hard rate limit of
prod.rateLimitBold: 5 certificate issuances per registered domain per week
prod.body2: . Hitting the limit will block all TLS renewal for that domain for 7 days.
prod.body3: Only switch when you have verified that staging issuance works end-to-end. You must also accept the
prod.confirm: I accept the TOS — switch to production
request.title: Request Let's Encrypt Certificate
request.description: An HTTP-01 challenge will be served via the running proxy. The host must be publicly reachable on port 80.
request.emailHint: Let's Encrypt sends expiry reminders here if provided. Leave empty to register without a contact — issuance is unchanged.
acme.title: ACME configuration
acme.description: Account settings shared across all certificate orders. Defaults to the Let's Encrypt staging environment.
acme.accountEmailHint: Required for Let's Encrypt registration. Also used as the default contact email when requesting certs.
acme.productionRateLimit: Rate limit: 5 issuances per registered domain per week.
acme.stagingNote: Staging environment — certificates are not trusted by browsers but issuance is unlimited.
acme.tosMissingWarning: Production is enabled but TOS acceptance is not recorded. New orders will be rejected by the backend until TOS is accepted.
toast.orderInFlightDesc: A certificate request for this host is already pending.
toast.clientNotInitDesc: Background ACME task hasn't started yet. Reload in a few seconds.
toast.alreadyRenewingDesc: A renewal for this host is already in flight.
